-- The proof-shape ratchet's red control.
--
-- `scripts/test-trust-gate.sh` appends this to a LIBRARY source of its scratch tree whose
-- pinned `first` ceiling in `generated/proof-shape.tsv` is zero. Nothing compiles it: the gate
-- tokenizes the file, counts one `first` followed by `|`, finds it above the ceiling, and
-- refuses. Remove the `|` and the same word is a binder name and is not counted, which is the
-- other half of the rule.
example : True := by
  first
    | trivial
    | exact True.intro
